full_page.content:
1935, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 315 Mar. 14 Charles Smith - 10 - abnormal Donald Staub - 9 - paralysis Girl wanted - Jos. Donovan, 9953 Manor - Phone Hogart 8342 Mrs. H. S. Laskey - 56 - fears goiter oper'n
Joseph Marney - 5 - leakage of heart from severe whooping cough. Drs. all agree nothing can be done to save him. Enrolled in S.M.A. last Monday improved a little. Father had been away from Com. long years. Has been since. We'll hope.
16 Ernst Haslen - 42 - like possessed. Father and grandfather prac- ticed magic & so called witch craft - Always afraid though 225 1bs and picture of physical health. Afraid to go out except when at least half drunk. Enrolled To-day 50c. Wife asks prayers. He seems to try to do right.
Page 316 Page 317
Blank Page.
Mar. 16 Mrs. Mary Coppo - 64 - complication - convulsions in coma - very lit- tle hope - perpetual enro Iment starts last Tuesday ... finished To- night.
17 Mrs. A. A. McIntosh - 28 - fearful chills and fever - 20 min. in chill last night followed by fever at 107 - Enrolled at 11 a.m. - 26th a.m. blood transfusion - Drs. still in doubt as to cause. 22nd (2:15 a.m.) phone ... have found "germ" ... Fever 107 ... 6 a.m. 105 ... at 9:30 3rd transfusion.
Sister M. Lyvaria of St. Anthony Parish - one of two cooks of 46 sis- ters fell down stairs badly bruised ... anxious to relieve "poor sister" who has to do all.
John Jackowiski - 21 - Epileptic 5 yrs. Enrolled Today 3.00
18 Casimir Nowak - 46 - has wife and six for about three years - curses drinks, no faith any more- Wife heart-broken.
19 Ida Davenport - 52 - operation To-morrow - cancer feared. . . . has 5 daughters & 2 boys at home - 1 son married - 3 deceased.
Geo Van Walleghen - 5 - scarlet fever
R. Hergenroether - 17 - feared loss of eye, come to monastery, when Dr's had given up hopes of saving it. Quite improved since enrolled. Enrolled today again promising perpet'l if helped.
